note: Every project we can make a video with, what it is good for, and the exact command. Pick by job, then mix: one clip is rarely the video.

items.name: MuJoCo B-roll
items.makes: real physics B-roll (domino chain, tower collapse, pendulum, collisions) and full mixes: physics + avatar + caption cards
items.when: a claim needs motion you cannot film — saturation, cascades, damping, impact
items.cost: CPU only, ~2-3 min per 12 s at 720x1280

items.name: LivLiv Player (talking avatar)
items.makes: 2.5D character that speaks with lip-sync, no face, no GPU
items.when: the video needs a presenter or a character voice instead of a narrator
items.cmd: see skill livliv-avatar-video (stage.html + env.json + CDP capture)
items.cost: ~5 frames/s on CPU; a 12 s clip ≈ 3 min

items.name: Gabimaru PNGTuber
items.makes: our own masked-ninja avatar frames (closed/open/blink) + monologue renders
items.when: channel identity videos, intros, in-character pieces

items.name: Aesthetic notes shorts
items.makes: handwritten-notebook math explainers (TTS + notes page + motion + music)
items.when: math/education topic with a visual derivation
items.cmd: python aesthetic_notes.py out/notes_vNN_short.mp4  (subject gate runs first)
items.cost: CPU, a few minutes; 127 renders to date

items.name: ALGORHYTHM CS shorts
items.makes: computer-science shorts with diagrams, code and narration
items.when: CS concept, system behaviour, algorithm intuition
items.cmd: see run_cs_shorts.sh (cron) / build scripts in the folder

items.name: faceless-youtube pipeline
items.makes: the main long/short pipeline: script → TTS → scenes → motion → upload
items.when: standard DOPEAK output; anything that must end up published
items.cmd: see PLAYBOOK.md (the operating contract) and pipeline_v3.py

items.name: Manim CE
items.makes: mathematical animation with exact geometry (3Blue1Brown style)
items.when: the idea IS the geometry: circles, limits, transforms, graphs
items.cmd: manim -pqh scene.py Scene (local-sys libs + TEXMFCNF needed)
items.cost: CPU, slow; keep scenes under ~20 s

items.name: Animation styles library
items.makes: 13 coded motion styles (kinetic type, grid, glitch...) as JS samples
items.when: the video needs a look, not a simulation — pick a style and drive it with our text

items.name: ClaudeAnimationBase (p5.brush)
items.makes: hand-drawn character acting (31 emotions) and soft painted stills
items.when: a mascot must emote, or a thumbnail needs a painted look
items.cost: ~18 s per 1280px still; full video ~19 s per frame — nightly only

items.name: CASE FILE longform
items.makes: documentary-style long episodes (evidence boards, maps, timelines)
items.when: a story with documents, dates and a verdict
items.cost: long render, run twice a week

items.name: microduck-short
items.makes: short assembly from clips + audio (one build.py)
items.when: you already have footage and only need the cut

items.name: ffmpeg
items.makes: encode, concat, mux audio, burn cards, loudnorm, loop, trim
items.when: always — it is the last step of every pipeline above
items.cmd: ffmpeg -framerate 24 -i f%04d.png -i vo.mp3 -vf format=yuv420p -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -shortest out.mp4

mix_recipes.use: MuJoCo scene as background, Gabimaru PNGTuber (transparent frames) bottom-right with mouth from the VO envelope, drawtext cards on the VO timeline, one ffmpeg pass

mix_recipes.job: Concept that needs motion (queues, collapse, damping)
mix_recipes.use: physics-broll for the motion + faceless-youtube for narration/music + ffmpeg drawtext for the key line
mix_recipes.example: out/queue-collapse-de.mp4 — 3 scenes, 33 s, German VO, 4 caption cards

mix_recipes.use: terminal cards (short_llmapps.py pattern) + real screen evidence, never stock b-roll
mix_recipes.example: out/llmapps-de.mp4 — 144,280 stars, 57 apps, the audit line

mix_recipes.use: math-notes for the page, Manim when the geometry must move exactly
gabimaru-avatar or LivLiv for the face, faceless-youtube for the bed, captions from the VO envelope
